place.name: Store Mosse National Park
place.description: Store Mosse ("Big Marsh") is a national park in Småland in southern Sweden, located in the municipalities of Vaggeryd, Gnosjö and Värnamo. In total Store Mosse covers some 100 km2 (39 mi2); of these, some 77 km2 (30 mi2) were designated national park in 1983.
